episodeTitle.en: OpenAI’s Head of ChatGPT: We’re entering a new era of AI (again) | Tibo Sottiaux
episodeTitle.zh: OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 负责人：我们又一次迈入了 AI 的新时代｜Tibo Sottiaux

guestBioOfficial.zh: Tibo Sottiaux 在 OpenAI 负责 ChatGPT 和 Codex，经历了 Codex、ChatGPT Work 和 Dots 的推出。他直接与用户交流，关注同一款产品如何兼顾快速问答和耗时更长的工作。
guestBioOfficial.en: Tibo leads ChatGPT and Codex at OpenAI. His teams have shipped Codex, ChatGPT Work, and Dots. He stays close to the user community as those products expand from quick answers to longer-running work.

title.en: OpenAI’s Head of ChatGPT: We’re entering a new era of AI (again) | Tibo Sottiaux
title.zh: OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 负责人：我们又一次迈入了 AI 的新时代｜Tibo Sottiaux

summary.zh: DevDay 发布会之后，Tibo 解释团队为何把聊天与工作模式拉到一起。对话从一次切换操作，谈到跨任务的记忆，再到产品负责人怎样在快速迭代时听取用户意见、为判断失误负责。
summary.en: After DevDay, Tibo explains why chat and work modes are converging. The discussion moves from switching friction to long-lived memory and the accountability required to change a product quickly.

insights.title: 同一个人会在快问和深度工作之间切换
insights.detail: 反馈显示，喜欢工作模式的人有时也只想快速聊两句。把这些入口放在一起，能少让用户先猜自己该选哪种工具。
insights.detailEn: People who like work mode still want quick chat. Bringing them together removes a choice users otherwise have to make up front.
insights.titleEn: Quick chat and deep work coexist

insights.title: 记忆是否有用，看它能不能接上下一次任务
insights.detail: Tibo 描述了团队长期投入记忆一致性，以及用户在后来一次对话里发现 ChatGPT 记得先前细节的体验。
insights.detailEn: The team spent years on consistent memory. Its value becomes tangible when a later conversation can build on something said earlier.

insights.title: 让能改产品的人直接听到反馈
insights.detail: Tibo 把自主权与纠错责任放在一起：减少审批，也意味着听到用户说不对时，自己就要负责修正。
insights.detailEn: Autonomy comes with responsibility for correcting decisions. Direct contact with the community shortens that feedback path.

related.reason: 继续了解 ChatGPT 和 Codex 合并背后的工程与产品取舍。
related.reasonEn: The engineering and product trade-offs behind merging ChatGPT and Codex.
